# Gozzy Nwogbo — gozzynwogbo.com

> AI systems builder and transformation partner. Toronto, Canada. Nigerian.

## About

Gozzy Nwogbo builds AI systems that give organizations leverage they do not
have yet: knowledge systems, automations, and agents made to run inside a real
business. Business background, two years hands-on with frontier tools. He holds
an MSc in Digital Management from Ivey Business School and a BSc in Business
Administration from Boston University, concentrating in Management Strategy and
Management Information Systems.

## Now

- Currently building: Atomos, a governed AI knowledge layer where every output traces back to the rule that allowed it.
- Last shipped: Tender Radar, a hands-off agent that reads new federal tenders and emits a weekly can-bid / can't-bid digest.

## Experience

- Loop Tech Systems (launched as Loop Health; Jul 2023 to Nov 2025, venture closed): Co-founder, Head of Strategy & Expansion. Enterprise client engagements for Bupa Global, the NHS, and Boston Medical Center; telehealth transformation roadmap and workflow (~500 users, 4 features shipped); AI orchestration on n8n, Relevance AI, and Python that lifted client workflow throughput 2.3x.
- Ivey Business School, IDIS (May to Jul 2025): Strategy Consultant Intern. AI and digital-transformation strategy for CIBC, Autism Society of America, and Boys & Girls Club of London; built an agentic donor-engagement automation.
- MI-C3 International (Sep 2022 to Aug 2023): Software Engineer. Workflow-optimization features: SQL data models, monitoring dashboards, operational pipelines.
- Yale University (Jul to Sep 2020): Research Assistant. Incentive-design research; KPIs and study-parameter database; findings in the final paper.

## Projects

- [Second Brain / Open Brain](/projects/second-brain/): A working personal knowledge OS. MCP server, semantic search over pgvector, daily pipelines, 11,000+ entries across 59 knowledge domains. It runs his daily practice.
- [Obscura](/projects/obscura/): Automated ad pipeline. A blurb becomes a storyboard, drift-free character renders, and a scored MP4, gated by an ad-comprehension audit. Shipped end to end.
- [Bid & Investment Screening](/projects/infrastructure-bid-engine/): A full priced tender package in 3 days for a six-country infrastructure group, plus an investment screen that caught a falsified growth claim.
- [Tender Radar](/projects/tender-radar/): Hands-off cron agent screening federal tenders, can-bid or cannot-bid with the decisive clause, weekly digest.
- [Scribe / Scribe Scout](/projects/scribe/): Content engine drafting from an atom graph, with discovery scored by argument intensity.
- [Healthcare Workflow Automation](/projects/healthcare-workflow/): Early-stage clinical workflow automation piloted across three Nigerian clinics.

## By the Work (verified counts from the working system)

- 430 automation workflows deployed in a live n8n instance, built on a core catalog where each workflow carries evals and a preferred trigger and storage pattern
- 11,000+ knowledge entries across 59 domains, cross-linked, with 107 session logs of daily use
- Distilled working methods from 50+ MasterClass instructors inside the corpus
- 2.3x client workflow throughput at Loop Tech Systems
- Full priced tender package in 3 days against a 4 to 6 week team baseline

## Expertise

Business judgment: business model analysis, investment screening, tender and bid strategy, AI transformation strategy
AI systems & agents: systems design, agent orchestration, MCP servers, retrieval and knowledge systems, LangChain, PostgreSQL / pgvector
Automation & delivery: n8n, Python, cron agents and pipelines, Supabase, Astro
